breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the dynamic amplification from a suddenly applied load; for a linear elastic bar, the peak stress is not the same as the static stress.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification omits the erroneous instruction 'take the peak stress to be the same as the static stress P/A.' Instead, it uses an energy-method framework—setting the work done by the suddenly applied load equal to the strain energy (P × δ_max = U) and deriving σ_max from δ_max—consistent with the ground truth's intent that the dynamic amplification factor emerge from the energy balance rather than being incorrectly suppressed.
